# billing API

Plans, checkout and the Stripe webhook (only with billing enabled).

Base path `/api/v1/billing` behind the gateway. Authentication, rate limits and the error format are the same for every service: see [Scripting MowDeck](../../guides/scripting.md). Rendered from [`apps/web/openapi/billing.json`](https://github.com/lukislp/mowdeck/blob/main/apps/web/openapi/billing.json) (OpenAPI 3.1), which you can also load into any OpenAPI tool.

## Operations

### billing

#### POST /api/v1/billing/checkout

**Checkout**

Start a hosted checkout for `plan`; redirect the browser to `url`.

422 when the plan is not sold here, 409 when the account already has a subscription (plan changes and cancellation happen in the customer portal).

**Request body** (required): `application/json` [CheckoutIn](#checkoutin)

| Status | Meaning | Body |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 200 | Successful Response | `application/json` [RedirectOut](#redirectout) |
| 422 | Validation Error | `application/json` [HTTPValidationError](#httpvalidationerror) |

#### GET /api/v1/billing/invoices

**Invoices**

The newest invoices of the caller's account (links to the provider's pages).

| Status | Meaning | Body |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 200 | Successful Response | `application/json` array of [InvoiceOut](#invoiceout) |

#### GET /api/v1/billing/operator/manual-refunds

**Manual Refunds**

Refunds of erased accounts that Billing could not make and the operator pays back by hand (ADR 0082), oldest first: the payment and invoice at the provider, amount, currency and why. Open ones only, with `settled=true` also those settled in the last 30 days. No record names an account.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `settled` | query | boolean | no | default `false` |

| Status | Meaning | Body |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 200 | Successful Response | `application/json` array of [ManualRefundOut](#manualrefundout) |
| 422 | Validation Error | `application/json` [HTTPValidationError](#httpvalidationerror) |

#### POST /api/v1/billing/operator/manual-refunds/{refund_id}/settle

**Settle Manual Refund**

Mark a manual refund as paid back. Settling again keeps the first time; 404 for an unknown id (or one deleted 30 days after it was settled).

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `refund_id` | path | string (uuid) | yes |  |

| Status | Meaning | Body |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 200 | Successful Response | `application/json` [ManualRefundOut](#manualrefundout) |
| 422 | Validation Error | `application/json` [HTTPValidationError](#httpvalidationerror) |

#### GET /api/v1/billing/operator/payments

**Payments**

The payments dashboard: revenue per month and currency (gross, refunds, net), the subscriptions per plan and status with the MRR, new and ended subscriptions, refunds by reason, failed payments, open and overdue invoices and disputes. Months are calendar months in the installation's report zone (`time_zone`: MOWDECK_BILLING_REPORT_TIMEZONE), amounts in the smallest currency unit and never added across currencies. Built from Billing's own data (the payments ledger written from webhooks since the deploy that added it, the subscription and invoice rows); Stripe is not asked. No answer names an account.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `months` | query | integer | no | min 1; max 36; default `12` |

| Status | Meaning | Body |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 200 | Successful Response | `application/json` [PaymentsSummaryOut](#paymentssummaryout) |
| 422 | Validation Error | `application/json` [HTTPValidationError](#httpvalidationerror) |

#### GET /api/v1/billing/operator/prices

**Prices**

Every price of the price file as Stripe has it (the same cache as `GET /status`), also for plans Entitlements does not offer. Read only: prices are maintained in Stripe.

| Status | Meaning | Body |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 200 | Successful Response | `application/json` [OperatorPricesOut](#operatorpricesout) |

#### POST /api/v1/billing/portal

**Portal**

Open the provider's customer portal (payment method, invoices, plan change, cancel).

404 before the account's first checkout.

| Status | Meaning | Body |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 200 | Successful Response | `application/json` [RedirectOut](#redirectout) |

#### GET /api/v1/billing/status

**Status**

Billing runs here: the provider, the currency and the plans on sale with prices.

Public (a pricing view needs no login). The web app probes it: a network error or 404 (the service is not deployed, billing is disabled) hides every billing element.

| Status | Meaning | Body |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 200 | Successful Response | `application/json` [BillingStatusOut](#billingstatusout) |

#### GET /api/v1/billing/subscription

**Subscription**

The subscription of the caller's account (`subscription: null` before checkout).

| Status | Meaning | Body |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 200 | Successful Response | `application/json` [SubscriptionSummaryOut](#subscriptionsummaryout) |

#### POST /api/v1/billing/webhooks/stripe

**Stripe Webhook**

Stripe events. No token: only the `Stripe-Signature` over the raw body counts.

400 for an invalid signature, 200 for a handled or repeated event (each event id is processed once), 500 when handling failed (Stripe retries).

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `stripe-signature` | header | string or null | no |  |

| Status | Meaning | Body |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 200 | Successful Response | `application/json` [WebhookOut](#webhookout) |
| 422 | Validation Error | `application/json` [HTTPValidationError](#httpvalidationerror) |

## Schemas

### BillingStatusOut

`GET /status`: billing runs in this installation and what it sells.

The service only runs when billing is enabled, so a reachable endpoint always says `enabled: true`; the web app treats a network error or 404 as "billing disabled".

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `automatic_tax` | boolean | yes | Stripe Tax calculates VAT in Checkout. |
| `currency` | string | yes |  |
| `enabled` | boolean | no | default `true` |
| `plans` | array of [StatusPlanOut](#statusplanout) | yes |  |
| `provider` | string | yes |  |

### CheckoutIn

Body of `POST /checkout`.

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `plan` | string | yes | pattern `^[a-z][a-z0-9_-]{0,63}$` |

### CurrencyOut

A currency the dashboard shows amounts in.

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `code` | string | yes | ISO 4217, lower case. |
| `exponent` | integer | yes | Decimals of the provider amount: 2 for EUR (990 is 9.90), 0 for JPY, 3 for KWD (Stripe's rules). |

### ManualRefundOut

A refund of an erased account that the operator pays back by hand (ADR 0082). It names the payment and the invoice at the provider, never the account.

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `amount` | integer | yes | Smallest currency unit (cents; whole yen for JPY). |
| `created_at` | string (date-time) | yes |  |
| `currency` | string | yes |  |
| `id` | string (uuid) | yes |  |
| `invoice_ref` | string or null | yes | The provider's invoice. |
| `payment_ref` | string | yes | The provider's payment (PaymentIntent or charge). |
| `reason` | string | yes | Why the refund could not be made at the provider. |
| `settled_at` | string (date-time) or null | yes | When the operator marked it paid back. |

| `amount` | integer | yes | Smallest unit, rounded half up. |
| `currency` | string | yes |  |
| `subscriptions` | integer | yes |  |

### PaymentsSummaryOut

| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `currencies` | array of [CurrencyOut](#currencyout) | yes |  |
| `generated_at` | string (date-time) | yes |  |

| `time_zone` | string | yes | IANA time zone of the month buckets (MOWDECK_BILLING_REPORT_TIMEZONE), e.g. Europe/Berlin; the web app passes it to Identity's deletion statistics. |
